references.name: intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build invoice_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis with invoice, customer, dates, amounts, and customer attributes. Build invoice_line_details by joining staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line to staging.stg_quickbooks__item on item_id; include only lines with a non-null item_id and a positive, non-null amount; select invoice_id, item attributes, quantity, unit price, and line revenue. For product_cost_analysis per qualifying line: - Treat purchase_cost as a decimal and missing values as 0 to derive item_cost_per_unit. - Compute total_item_cost as quantity (missing treated as 0) times item_cost_per_unit. - Compute line_gross_profit as line_revenue minus total_item_cost. - Compute line_gross_margin_pct as (line_gross_profit / line_revenue) expressed as a percentage rounded to two decimals; if line_revenue is not positive, set to 0. A product_profitability CTE is also derived (product-level KPIs) but not joined to the final output. For invoice_profitability, left join invoice_details to product_cost_analysis by invoice_id and aggregate: - total_cogs: sum of total_item_cost; null if no qualifying lines exist. - gross_profit: sum of line_gross_profit; null if no qualifying lines exist. - invoice_gross_margin_pct: if invoice_total > 0, gross_profit divided by invoice_total as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - unique_products: count of distinct item_id on qualifying lines (0 if none). - total_quantity: sum of quantity (null if no qualifying lines). - avg_product_margin: average of line_gross_margin_pct (null if no qualifying lines). - profitability_tier: based on gross_profit / invoice_total thresholds (>0.4 Highly Profitable; >0.2 Profitable; >0.1 Marginally Profitable; >0 Break Even; otherwise Loss Making, including when the ratio is null or non-positive). For customer_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by customer_id: - total_revenue, total_cogs, total_gross_profit as sums. - customer_gross_margin_pct: if total_revenue > 0, total_gross_profit divided by total_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if total_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - avg_profit_per_invoice: average of gross_profit (ignores nulls). - margin_volatility: standard deviation of invoice_gross_margin_pct (ignores nulls; null if fewer than two non-null values). - profit_last_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the last 6 months relative to current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - profit_prev_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the 6–12 month window before current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - customer_profit_tier: thresholded by total_gross_profit (>=20000 High, >=5000 Medium, >=1000 Low, >0 Minimal, else Loss). For monthly_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by revenue_month_start, year, and quarter: - monthly_invoices and monthly_customers as distinct counts. - monthly_revenue, monthly_cogs, monthly_gross_profit as sums. - monthly_gross_margin_pct: if monthly_revenue > 0, monthly_gross_profit divided by monthly_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if monthly_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - profit_per_customer and profit_per_invoice as sums divided by distinct counts; avg_products_per_invoice as the average unique_products (not used downstream). Final output selects all invoice-level metrics and left joins customer_profitability by customer_id and monthly_profitability by revenue_month_start. Derivations: - customer_profit_growth_pct: if previous 6-month profit > 0, ((last 6 months − previous 6 months) / previous 6 months) as a percentage rounded to two decimals; otherwise null. - relative_performance: compare invoice gross_profit to the customer’s avg_profit_per_invoice (Above Average if >1.5×, Average if >0.8×, else Below; a null comparator yields Below). - risk_adjusted_profit: equals gross_profit when outstanding_balance = 0; if outstanding_balance > 0, scale gross_profit by the collection ratio (collected_amount / invoice_total); otherwise equals gross_profit. - profitability_sustainability: tiers based on invoice_gross_margin_pct and customer_margin_volatility (>30% and <10 Highly Sustainable; >20% and <20 Sustainable; >10% Moderately Sustainable; >0% Low Sustainability; else Unsustainable). Aggregations follow standard null handling (aggregates ignore nulls; sums of only nulls yield null; explicit zeros are used in the 6‑month window sums). The final result set is ordered by transaction_date descending, then gross_profit descending.'

business_logic: 'Build invoice_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis with invoice, customer, dates, amounts, and customer attributes. Build invoice_line_details by joining staging.stg_quickbooks__invoice_line to staging.stg_quickbooks__item on item_id; include only lines with a non-null item_id and a positive, non-null amount; select invoice_id, item attributes, quantity, unit price, and line revenue. For product_cost_analysis per qualifying line: - Treat purchase_cost as a decimal and missing values as 0 to derive item_cost_per_unit. - Compute total_item_cost as quantity (missing treated as 0) times item_cost_per_unit. - Compute line_gross_profit as line_revenue minus total_item_cost. - Compute line_gross_margin_pct as (line_gross_profit / line_revenue) expressed as a percentage rounded to two decimals; if line_revenue is not positive, set to 0. A product_profitability CTE is also derived (product-level KPIs) but not joined to the final output. For invoice_profitability, left join invoice_details to product_cost_analysis by invoice_id and aggregate: - total_cogs: sum of total_item_cost; null if no qualifying lines exist. - gross_profit: sum of line_gross_profit; null if no qualifying lines exist. - invoice_gross_margin_pct: if invoice_total > 0, gross_profit divided by invoice_total as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - unique_products: count of distinct item_id on qualifying lines (0 if none). - total_quantity: sum of quantity (null if no qualifying lines). - avg_product_margin: average of line_gross_margin_pct (null if no qualifying lines). - profitability_tier: based on gross_profit / invoice_total thresholds (>0.4 Highly Profitable; >0.2 Profitable; >0.1 Marginally Profitable; >0 Break Even; otherwise Loss Making, including when the ratio is null or non-positive). For customer_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by customer_id: - total_revenue, total_cogs, total_gross_profit as sums. - customer_gross_margin_pct: if total_revenue > 0, total_gross_profit divided by total_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if total_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - avg_profit_per_invoice: average of gross_profit (ignores nulls). - margin_volatility: standard deviation of invoice_gross_margin_pct (ignores nulls; null if fewer than two non-null values). - profit_last_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the last 6 months relative to current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - profit_prev_6_months: sum of gross_profit for invoices with revenue_month_start in the 6–12 month window before current date; invoices outside the window contribute 0. - customer_profit_tier: thresholded by total_gross_profit (>=20000 High, >=5000 Medium, >=1000 Low, >0 Minimal, else Loss). For monthly_profitability, aggregate invoice_profitability by revenue_month_start, year, and quarter: - monthly_invoices and monthly_customers as distinct counts. - monthly_revenue, monthly_cogs, monthly_gross_profit as sums. - monthly_gross_margin_pct: if monthly_revenue > 0, monthly_gross_profit divided by monthly_revenue as a percentage rounded to two decimals (null if monthly_gross_profit is missing); otherwise 0. - profit_per_customer and profit_per_invoice as sums divided by distinct counts; avg_products_per_invoice as the average unique_products (not used downstream). Final output selects all invoice-level metrics and left joins customer_profitability by customer_id and monthly_profitability by revenue_month_start. Derivations: - customer_profit_growth_pct: if previous 6-month profit > 0, ((last 6 months − previous 6 months) / previous 6 months) as a percentage rounded to two decimals; otherwise null. - relative_performance: compare invoice gross_profit to the customer’s avg_profit_per_invoice (Above Average if >1.5×, Average if >0.8×, else Below; a null comparator yields Below). - risk_adjusted_profit: equals gross_profit when outstanding_balance = 0; if outstanding_balance > 0, scale gross_profit by the collection ratio (collected_amount / invoice_total); otherwise equals gross_profit. - profitability_sustainability: tiers based on invoice_gross_margin_pct and customer_margin_volatility (>30% and <10 Highly Sustainable; >20% and <20 Sustainable; >10% Moderately Sustainable; >0% Low Sustainability; else Unsustainable). Aggregations follow standard null handling (aggregates ignore nulls; sums of only nulls yield null; explicit zeros are used in the 6‑month window sums). The final result set is ordered by transaction_date descending, then gross_profit descending.'

- name: quickbooks__vendor_performance
      description: Vendor performance summary per vendor_id and source with spend trends, payment behavior, scores, ratings, risks, and strategy.
      grain: One row per vendor_id + source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis
      business_logic: '- Build vendor_base from intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis (fields used: vendor_id, source_relation, spend_month_start, bill_date, total_amount, bill_id, payment_status, payment_timeliness, outstanding_balance, purchase_category, vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level). - Compute vendor_spend_trends grouped by vendor_id + source_relation: - active_months: distinct count of spend_month_start (NULLs ignored). - first_transaction_date/last_transaction_date: earliest/latest bill_date; days_since_last_transaction: difference in days from today to last_transaction_date (NULL if no bill_date). - total_lifetime_spend: sum of total_amount (NULLs ignored); avg_bill_amount: average total_amount (NULLs ignored); spend_volatility: sample standard deviation of total_amount (NULL if fewer than two non-NULL); total_transactions: distinct count of bill_id (NULLs ignored). - spend_current_quarter: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current quarter; months outside contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_quarter: sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window (from quarter_start-3 months up to but before quarter_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_current_year: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current calendar year; outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_year: sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window (from year_start-1 year up to but before current year_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - payment_completion_rate: fully paid bill count divided by total rows, multiplied by 100 (not rounded). - on_time_payment_rate: on-time/early payment count divided by rows excluding ''Incomplete Payment'', multiplied by 100; NULL when that denominator is zero (not rounded). - Compute vendor_category_analysis grouped by vendor_id + source_relation + purchase_category (excluding NULL categories): transaction count, total spend, average spend; rank categories by total spend descending per vendor (ties arbitrary). - Derive vendor_primary_category as the top-ranked category per vendor (ties resolved arbitrarily), exposing its name and spend. - Build vendor_scoring by left-joining vendor_spend_trends and vendor_primary_category to vendor_base on vendor_id + source_relation; aggregate total_outstanding as the sum of outstanding_balance (NULLs ignored; NULL if all NULL) and category_diversity as distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category; carry through vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level (if these vary within a vendor, multiple rows may result). - Compute four scores (each yields 25/20/15/10/5; NULL inputs fall into the lowest bucket of 5): - payment_reliability_score by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - timeliness_score by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - relationship_stability_score by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180. - business_value_score by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000. - Final computations: - overall_performance_score: sum of the four scores. - quarterly_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive. - annual_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive. - transaction_value_profile: classify by average transaction size (total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions): >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; when undefined (e.g., zero/NULL transactions) defaults to Low. - performance_rating: by overall_performance_score thresholds: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical. - risk_assessment (in priority order): outstanding >30% of lifetime spend High Financial Risk; inactivity >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time rate <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average bill amount High Volatility Risk; outstanding >15% Medium Financial Risk; inactivity >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk. - recommended_strategy (in priority order): high overall (≥85) with strategic/major tier Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity (≤60 days) Maintain Relationship; low payment rates (on-time <70 or completion <80) Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 days Re-engage or Replace; outstanding >20% Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance. - avg_monthly_spend: total_lifetime_spend ÷ active_months, rounded to two decimals (NULL when active_months is zero). - avg_transaction_size: total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions, rounded to two decimals (NULL when total_transactions is zero). - dependency_level: based on primary_category_spend thresholds: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal (NULL treated as Minimal). - Exclude rows with missing vendor_id; sort results by overall_performance_score descending, then total_lifetime_spend descending.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from source; rows with missing vendor_id are excluded; part of the grain with source_relation.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source dataset identifier; forms the grain with vendor_id; NULL values group together.
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor company name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor display name from source; passed through as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: total_lifetime_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total of total_amount for the vendor and source; NULL amounts are ignored; NULL if none are non-NULL.
      - name: avg_bill_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average total_amount per bill for the vendor and source; NULL amounts are ignored; NULL if none are non-NULL.
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of bill_id for the vendor and source; NULL bill_id values are ignored; 0 if none.
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of spend_month_start for the vendor and source; NULL values are ignored; 0 if none.
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest bill_date for the vendor and source; NULL if no bill_date.
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest bill_date for the vendor and source; NULL if no bill_date.
      - name: days_since_last_transaction
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days from today to last_transaction_date; NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL.
      - name: spend_current_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current quarter start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_prev_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_current_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current year start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_prev_year
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.
      - name: spend_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of total_amount across bills; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL amounts.
      - name: payment_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Fully paid bills as a percentage of all rows for the vendor and source; not rounded.
      - name: on_time_payment_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: On-time/early payments as a percentage of rows excluding 'Incomplete Payment'; NULL when that denominator is zero; not rounded.
      - name: total_outstanding
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Sum of outstanding_balance across vendor rows; NULLs ignored; NULL if all are NULL.
      - name: primary_purchase_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Highest-spend purchase_category per vendor and source; ties resolved arbitrarily; NULL if none.
      - name: primary_category_spend
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Total spend in the primary_purchase_category; NULL if no category.
      - name: category_diversity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category values per vendor and source.
      - name: vendor_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor tier from source (e.g., Strategic Vendor, Major Vendor); used in risk and strategy rules.
      - name: payment_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Payment risk level from source; carried for context.
      - name: payment_reliability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score (25/20/15/10/5) by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65; defaults to 5 when rate is NULL.'
      - name: timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score (25/20/15/10/5) by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65; defaults to 5 when rate is NULL.'
      - name: relationship_stability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score (25/20/15/10/5) by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180; defaults to 5 when NULL.'
      - name: business_value_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score (25/20/15/10/5) by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000; defaults to 5 when NULL.'
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of payment_reliability, timeliness, relationship_stability, and business_value scores.
      - name: quarterly_spend_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive.
      - name: annual_spend_growth_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive.
      - name: transaction_value_profile
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification by average transaction size: >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; defaults to Low when undefined.'
      - name: performance_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Rating by overall_performance_score: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical.'
      - name: risk_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority rules: >30% outstanding High Financial Risk; >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average High Volatility Risk; >15% outstanding Medium Financial Risk; >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk.'
      - name: recommended_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority rules: high overall with strategic/major Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity Maintain Relationship; low payment rates Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 Re-engage or Replace; >20% outstanding Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance.'
      - name: avg_monthly_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total lifetime spend divided by active months, rounded to two decimals; NULL when active_months is zero.
      - name: avg_transaction_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total lifetime spend divided by total_transactions, rounded to two decimals; NULL when total_transactions is zero.
      - name: dependency_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on primary_category_spend: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal; NULL treated as Minimal.'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build vendor_base from intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis (fields used: vendor_id, source_relation, spend_month_start, bill_date, total_amount, bill_id, payment_status, payment_timeliness, outstanding_balance, purchase_category, vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level). - Compute vendor_spend_trends grouped by vendor_id + source_relation: - active_months: distinct count of spend_month_start (NULLs ignored). - first_transaction_date/last_transaction_date: earliest/latest bill_date; days_since_last_transaction: difference in days from today to last_transaction_date (NULL if no bill_date). - total_lifetime_spend: sum of total_amount (NULLs ignored); avg_bill_amount: average total_amount (NULLs ignored); spend_volatility: sample standard deviation of total_amount (NULL if fewer than two non-NULL); total_transactions: distinct count of bill_id (NULLs ignored). - spend_current_quarter: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current quarter; months outside contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_quarter: sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window (from quarter_start-3 months up to but before quarter_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_current_year: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current calendar year; outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_year: sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window (from year_start-1 year up to but before current year_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - payment_completion_rate: fully paid bill count divided by total rows, multiplied by 100 (not rounded). - on_time_payment_rate: on-time/early payment count divided by rows excluding ''Incomplete Payment'', multiplied by 100; NULL when that denominator is zero (not rounded). - Compute vendor_category_analysis grouped by vendor_id + source_relation + purchase_category (excluding NULL categories): transaction count, total spend, average spend; rank categories by total spend descending per vendor (ties arbitrary). - Derive vendor_primary_category as the top-ranked category per vendor (ties resolved arbitrarily), exposing its name and spend. - Build vendor_scoring by left-joining vendor_spend_trends and vendor_primary_category to vendor_base on vendor_id + source_relation; aggregate total_outstanding as the sum of outstanding_balance (NULLs ignored; NULL if all NULL) and category_diversity as distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category; carry through vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level (if these vary within a vendor, multiple rows may result). - Compute four scores (each yields 25/20/15/10/5; NULL inputs fall into the lowest bucket of 5): - payment_reliability_score by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - timeliness_score by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - relationship_stability_score by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180. - business_value_score by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000. - Final computations: - overall_performance_score: sum of the four scores. - quarterly_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive. - annual_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive. - transaction_value_profile: classify by average transaction size (total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions): >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; when undefined (e.g., zero/NULL transactions) defaults to Low. - performance_rating: by overall_performance_score thresholds: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical. - risk_assessment (in priority order): outstanding >30% of lifetime spend High Financial Risk; inactivity >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time rate <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average bill amount High Volatility Risk; outstanding >15% Medium Financial Risk; inactivity >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk. - recommended_strategy (in priority order): high overall (≥85) with strategic/major tier Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity (≤60 days) Maintain Relationship; low payment rates (on-time <70 or completion <80) Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 days Re-engage or Replace; outstanding >20% Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance. - avg_monthly_spend: total_lifetime_spend ÷ active_months, rounded to two decimals (NULL when active_months is zero). - avg_transaction_size: total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions, rounded to two decimals (NULL when total_transactions is zero). - dependency_level: based on primary_category_spend thresholds: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal (NULL treated as Minimal). - Exclude rows with missing vendor_id; sort results by overall_performance_score descending, then total_lifetime_spend descending.'

business_logic: '- Build vendor_base from intermediate.int_quickbooks__vendor_spend_analysis (fields used: vendor_id, source_relation, spend_month_start, bill_date, total_amount, bill_id, payment_status, payment_timeliness, outstanding_balance, purchase_category, vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level). - Compute vendor_spend_trends grouped by vendor_id + source_relation: - active_months: distinct count of spend_month_start (NULLs ignored). - first_transaction_date/last_transaction_date: earliest/latest bill_date; days_since_last_transaction: difference in days from today to last_transaction_date (NULL if no bill_date). - total_lifetime_spend: sum of total_amount (NULLs ignored); avg_bill_amount: average total_amount (NULLs ignored); spend_volatility: sample standard deviation of total_amount (NULL if fewer than two non-NULL); total_transactions: distinct count of bill_id (NULLs ignored). - spend_current_quarter: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current quarter; months outside contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_quarter: sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window (from quarter_start-3 months up to but before quarter_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_current_year: sum of total_amount for months on/after the start of the current calendar year; outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - spend_prev_year: sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window (from year_start-1 year up to but before current year_start); outside months contribute zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if no months qualify. - payment_completion_rate: fully paid bill count divided by total rows, multiplied by 100 (not rounded). - on_time_payment_rate: on-time/early payment count divided by rows excluding ''Incomplete Payment'', multiplied by 100; NULL when that denominator is zero (not rounded). - Compute vendor_category_analysis grouped by vendor_id + source_relation + purchase_category (excluding NULL categories): transaction count, total spend, average spend; rank categories by total spend descending per vendor (ties arbitrary). - Derive vendor_primary_category as the top-ranked category per vendor (ties resolved arbitrarily), exposing its name and spend. - Build vendor_scoring by left-joining vendor_spend_trends and vendor_primary_category to vendor_base on vendor_id + source_relation; aggregate total_outstanding as the sum of outstanding_balance (NULLs ignored; NULL if all NULL) and category_diversity as distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category; carry through vendor_name, vendor_company_name, vendor_display_name, vendor_tier, payment_risk_level (if these vary within a vendor, multiple rows may result). - Compute four scores (each yields 25/20/15/10/5; NULL inputs fall into the lowest bucket of 5): - payment_reliability_score by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - timeliness_score by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65. - relationship_stability_score by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180. - business_value_score by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000. - Final computations: - overall_performance_score: sum of the four scores. - quarterly_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive. - annual_spend_growth_pct: percentage change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive. - transaction_value_profile: classify by average transaction size (total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions): >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; when undefined (e.g., zero/NULL transactions) defaults to Low. - performance_rating: by overall_performance_score thresholds: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical. - risk_assessment (in priority order): outstanding >30% of lifetime spend High Financial Risk; inactivity >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time rate <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average bill amount High Volatility Risk; outstanding >15% Medium Financial Risk; inactivity >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk. - recommended_strategy (in priority order): high overall (≥85) with strategic/major tier Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity (≤60 days) Maintain Relationship; low payment rates (on-time <70 or completion <80) Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 days Re-engage or Replace; outstanding >20% Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance. - avg_monthly_spend: total_lifetime_spend ÷ active_months, rounded to two decimals (NULL when active_months is zero). - avg_transaction_size: total_lifetime_spend ÷ total_transactions, rounded to two decimals (NULL when total_transactions is zero). - dependency_level: based on primary_category_spend thresholds: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal (NULL treated as Minimal). - Exclude rows with missing vendor_id; sort results by overall_performance_score descending, then total_lifetime_spend descending.'
